title: CES Result Message
description: Signal that CES has finished processing a submission. Results already written to DB by CES (D-81). api uses this to push WebSocket notification to student. Includes execution_status and test case counts so api does not need to query DB.

status.description: Processing outcome. completed = all test cases processed (pass or fail). error = infrastructure/system error (Judge0 down, DB write failed).

execution_status.description: Final submission-level status. Mirrors submissions.execution_status already written to DB by CES.

testcases_passed.description: Number of test cases with status=accepted
